newsitem.title: USA: Homeland Holding Q1 EBITDA up, sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Homeland Holding Q1 EBITDA up, sales fall.

text.p: Homeland Holding Corp said Monday its earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization was $5.7 million versus $3.8 million, or a 48 percent increase over the same quarter last year.

The company, a supermarket chain in Oklahoma, southern Kansas and the Texas panhandle with 66 stores, said sales for first quarter 1997 were $120.1 million, a 3.5 percent decline over the corresponding period of 1996.
It said same-store sales fell 1.1 percent.
